text: Meet the  Staff: Victor Monroy (he/him), Research Assistant. “HQ es un lugar donde cualquier persona gay o transgénero puede sentirse bienvenido y seguro que recibirá la mejor atención para cuidar tanto su salud mental como sexual.". #MyHQToronto
qualitative_notes: The post is structured as an informational staff profile and contains an attributed quotation explicitly describing a safe and welcoming service for gay and transgender people. Although the quoted content strongly matches the benchmark's Hope Speech criteria, the gold label is Non Hope Speech. The instance therefore represents both informational or attributed supportive discourse and a potential annotation-boundary case in which the gold label is contestable under the operational guidelines.
